name: ANSI smoke detector plan symbol
summary: US-style plan symbol for a smoke detector: a circle or square with SD or S marking on the ceiling plan.
description: US fire alarm plans commonly draw smoke detectors as a circle tagged SD or a square with an S, with a subscript for duct or beam types. The form follows the project legend, which often adapts NFPA-based fire alarm conventions.

Addresses and circuit numbers are written beside the symbol. The plan is checked against spacing rules for smooth and beamed ceilings and against obstructions. The tag does not distinguish photoelectric from ionisation detectors. The legend or device schedule does.
readingNotes: Read subscripts for duct or beam types.
distinction: The IEC-style smoke detector plan symbol serves the same purpose with a different internal mark.
